paragraphs: A workday repeats bend, lift, and set down. Workers pick orders and push carts between shelves in the morning, then load and unload vehicles and stack boxes on pallets in the afternoon. Supermarket replenishment must finish before opening. In peak seasons, trucks queue and loading crews work continuously. Forklift ability adds a valuable skill and raises pay.

In short: pick, load, unload, palletize, organize, and replenish. Duties include order picking, loading and unloading, warehouse stacking, tool-assisted movement, equipment collaboration, and safety maintenance.
